bestBets.overview: ALL INTRIGUE tried hard in the Sires' Produce before not getting room when required when having her first try against older rivals. Give her another chance. BAILED faces a sharp rise in trip but has made good ground from the back on the Pakenham synthetic at his first two attempts. COME TO LIGHT worked home soundly on debut before enduring a wide run at his second attempt. WHITE STAR SUZIE was specked at healthy odds and found the line nicely when having her first try on synthetic.

raceTips.comment: Bailed brings in strong form coming from Victoria. He attacked the line good style last start and looks ready to win now third up. Gym Princess was doing her best work late last start and looks suited here. White Star Suzie has place claims.

BRUTAL EMPIRE has been game in defeat at both runs back from a break and should be playing a role in the finish again with any luck from the wide gate. RUM'UN found little after facing the breeze at his second attempt but led and gave a good sight on debut. MACELLEROY is another drawn poorly but he's also won his past two trials at this track.

raceTips.comment: Alkira has good ability and has trialled up nicely. She'll roll forward and could be hard to rundown. Brutal Empire attacked the line in good style last start and looks well placed here.

bestBets.overview: HOULIHAN was just even off a quieter ride last time but had been good from on speed at her first three runs this prep. She can bounce back ridden more assertively. PARTY DAY found form quickly last time in and has tuned up for this with a trial win at this track. CELESTIAL GLOW was never a threat last start but hit the line hard to just miss second up. JUST PLAIN NUTS disappointed on turf second up but was close up here when resuming and maps to get a gun run in transit.

raceTips.comment: Geegeeschaser should improve from a sound first up run. Now fitter she should control this race and be hard to rundown. Party Day has a great record and can sprint well fresh. Houlihan has the ability to win here but was plain last start.

bestBets.overview: TUSKEGEE just failed to wear down all-the-way victor KIREINA MARUBRAH when resuming. He'll only be improved, drops 2kg and should get all the favours from the inside marble. He's a strong chance to go one better. His stablemate SIMPLY DEEP has scored tough on-pace wins at his past couple and will take plenty of wearing down again. THE SPIRIT OF ZERO has been good to the line at both runs back from a break and should again be strong when it counts. STARDARMUS was dominant when surprisingly leading last start.

raceTips.comment: Tuskegee looks well placed here now fitter second up, he was brave fresh running a nice 2nd. This is a very winnable race for him here. Simply Deep keeps winning and should get every favour leading. The Spirit Of Zero will be strong late here.

bestBets.overview: FIERCE 'N FABULOUS failed to finish off when resuming for the new yard but the second up effort was more like it. She'll be further improved and the rise to 1350m is a positive. COLONEL BOGEY enjoyed a gun run when notching an overdue maiden win second up and can go on now that his confidence is high. Former Victorian CITY WOK was warmly supported when scoring at his local debut and will be better for it. Respect any positive market moves on former Chris Waller representative CAVARETTA at her first local outing.

raceTips.comment: City Wok won in dominant style first up for the new stable, he was off the map in betting and won with a leg in the air. That race rated very highly suggesting that he's improved with the new stable. If he holds his form he'll be winning here. Fierce 'N' Fabulous looks a likely improver now fitter. Colonel Bogey is very consistent and has place claims.

bestBets.overview: AZONTO was disappointing as favourite two starts ago before letting down strongly to score last time. She can go on now that her confidence is back up. REGAL HUNTER was twice game in defeat over this route before another sound effort when back to turf at Hobart. RESPITE didn't have much luck from a wide gate last time but should get every chance to bounce back from the inside alley. COASTAL STRIKE will press forward from the outside gate and be in it for a long way.

raceTips.comment: Azonto got a well deserved win last start and can go back to back here in an even race. Coastal Strike should get every favour from the lead. Regal Hunter will be strong late, he has a big turn of foot. Respite has claims at odds.

bestBets.overview: SUSHI EXPRESS scored a tough on-pace win in this race last year and is still to be beaten from five tries at this trip. He looks a reliable each-way play in a small but open field. Hobart Cup winner, BLONDE STAR, failed to finish off fresh but has a strong second up record and can improve sharply. GARCON D'ESPOIR is bursting for another win having been game in defeat at all three runs this term. RUBBLEONTHEDOUBLE has been successful at two of three runs this time in and the rise to 1650m suits nicely.

raceTips.comment:
Garcon D'espoir drops significantly in the weights here and looks suited rising to the mile. Jett Stanley is a good jockey booking here, Jett has been in great form over the last 12 months. This looks a perfect race for him here and should be set to peak now fully fit. 
Sushi Express will get a nice run on speed and should improve here now fitter. Whippin Piccadilly is flying but has been winning in easier grade.

bestBets.overview: CHEROKEE DANCER has been game in the placings at her past two outings on this synthetic surface and has since won a trial here. She maps to enjoy a nice trail just off the pace and should be playing a role in the finish again. CAPTAIN CAM was never likely when out to 1350m third up but has let down strongly to score at this lesser trip either side of that. The speedy THOROS OF MYR draws to advantage and is sure to be in it for a long way. HARTMAN is racing well and has been freshened for the drop in trip.

raceTips.comment: Thoros Of Myr is well placed here. He loves this track and should get favours from the lead with Jett Stanley. The Real Man has won well in two runs for the new stable. Cherokee Dancer is very consistent and should be in the finish.
